slides.title:
My brand kit.
Built in an afternoon, for $20.
I brainstorm in Claude Design.
typed: I describe the feeling I want.
I love the show on Hulu called Shogun.
My son watches Samurai Rabbit on Netflix.

I want the intersection of dramatic,
cinematic and exciting.

marker.text: fastest ideation process I've ever used

slides.title: I export it to Canva.
typed:
Claude Design gives me the direction,
the concept, the system.

Canva gives me the execution,
the templates, the distribution.
dim:
There'll be some back and forth,
because it doesn't get it right
the first time.

print.caption: one of the templates, in Canva

slides.title: I refine.
typed: You'll not get it right in the first prompt.

That is not a flaw in the tool.
That is a process.
list: It will ask you to upgrade mid-session.

marker.text: this will be the worst it ever is

slides.title:
The philosophy still has to come from you.
Claude Design executes, you direct.
slides.foot: Save this for your next rebrand.
